# FMI 2.0 headers

The files in `headers/` are copied verbatim from the FMI 2.0.5 reference
implementation published by the Modelica Association Project "FMI" and are
licensed under the 2-Clause BSD License (BSD-2-Clause).  The license text is
embedded in each header.

They were taken from the sibling `pyfmi_sysml2` repository
(`src/pyfmi_sysml2/fmi2_headers/`) and are kept unmodified so that the FMI C
ABI matches every other generator in this workspace.  Do not edit them; update
them only by copying a newer upstream release.
